answer: Ivory Harberger-tax bond: each identity holds an ivory plot, prices it at dawn, and pays tax on that price. Anyone may buy it at that price; a sale burns the bond. A comet audit checks prices against recent sales, flagging rigged rings. First plot 40, k-th 40+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,036,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Rented plots fail: low invites buyout, high bleeds tax. Honest agents hold one true-priced plot, paying 40 per epoch.
